message:
Propose 2 or 3 scenarios. Reply with {"scenarios": [...]} as in the ripple-contracts skill.
- ids "A", "B", "C". "changes" reference node ids from "affected" ({"node", "set"} or {"node", "replace_with"}).
- burdens: one entry per affected group, "group" = the group id, "people" = its size, "minutes" = your estimate of time lost per person.
- "capacity" = capacity of the venue used in that scenario (null if unknown), "attendees" = the attendees group size.
- "extra_cost_eur": null when unknown. List every unverified fact in "to_confirm". Do not rank.
- "accessibility_ok" and "within_opening_hours" mean "not known to fail": set them to false ONLY when a source says the scenario fails that requirement. If unknown, keep true and add it to "to_confirm".
{"disruption":{"node":"workshop_s2","kind":"delayed","detail":"Speaker 2's train is 2 hours late; the Workshop by Speaker 2 (10:00-11:00, room B) is delayed by 120 minutes.","params":{"delay_minutes":120}},"affected":[{"id":"grp_speaker_2","type":"group","label":"Speaker 2","attrs":{"size":1,"session":"Workshop 10:00-11:00, room B"},"source":"people.csv","effect":"inform"},{"id":"grp_workshop_participants","type":"group","label":"Workshop participants","attrs":{"size":40},"source":"participants.csv","effect":"inform"},{"id":"venue_main_hall","type":"resource","label":"Main hall","attrs":{"capacity":250,"address":"[FICTIONAL ADDRESS]","date":"2026-11-21","replaced_by":"Espace Mont Louis (11e)"},"source":"schedule.json","effect":"context"},{"id":"workshop_s2","type":"schedule_item","label":"Workshop by Speaker 2","attrs":{"start":"10:00","end":"11:00","location":"Espace Mont Louis (11e), room B"},"source":"schedule.json","effect":"moved"}],"groups":[{"id":"grp_attendees","label":"Attendees","size":200},{"id":"grp_speakers","label":"Speakers","size":3},{"id":"grp_speaker_1","label":"Speaker 1","size":1},{"id":"grp_speaker_2","label":"Speaker 2","size":1},{"id":"grp_speaker_3","label":"Speaker 3","size":1},{"id":"grp_workshop_participants","label":"Workshop participants","size":40},{"id":"grp_volunteers","label":"Volunteers","size":12},{"id":"grp_caterer","label":"Green Fork Catering","size":1}],"candidates":[],"remaining_budget_eur":6000.0}
raw:
Now I have the contract. Building the scenarios from the given data only.

Key facts: the disruption delays the Workshop by Speaker 2 by 120 minutes (10:00–11:00 becomes 12:00–13:00 in room B at Espace Mont Louis). The only venue in the message is Espace Mont Louis (11e), with no capacity given, so it is `null`. Three alternatives are possible, but I have no data on their availability or capacity, so the scenarios stay within the known facts: keep the speaker's session at the new time, or move/shorten it. Burden estimates are labelled as estimates by the contract's design.

```json
{"scenarios": [
  {"id": "A", "title": "Run workshop 2 hours late in room B at Espace Mont Louis",
   "changes": [{"node": "workshop_s2", "set": {"start": "12:00", "end": "13:00", "location": "Espace Mont Louis (11e), room B"}}],
   "capacity": null, "attendees": 200, "extra_cost_eur": null,
   "accessibility_ok": true, "within_opening_hours": true,
   "burdens": [
     {"group": "grp_speaker_2", "people": 1, "minutes": 120, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_workshop_participants", "people": 40, "minutes": 120, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_attendees", "people": 200, "minutes": 0, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_volunteers", "people": 12, "minutes": 60, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_speakers", "people": 3, "minutes": 0, "must_replan": false}
   ],
   "to_confirm": ["Room B capacity at Espace Mont Louis (not stated in the sources)", "Room B availability from 12:00 to 13:00 on 2026-11-21", "Whether Speaker 2 can attend at 12:00 after the train delay", "Whether Workshop participants can attend 12:00-13:00 and whether the rest of the day's schedule is affected", "Volunteer staffing for the shifted session (estimate of 60 minutes is an estimate, not sourced)", "Whether room B at Espace Mont Louis meets accessibility needs (not checked)"]},

  {"id": "B", "title": "Shift workshop 2 to 12:00-13:00 in room B and inform participants of the change",
   "changes": [{"node": "workshop_s2", "set": {"start": "12:00", "end": "13:00"}}],
   "capacity": null, "attendees": 200, "extra_cost_eur": null,
   "accessibility_ok": true, "within_opening_hours": true,
   "burdens": [
     {"group": "grp_speaker_2", "people": 1, "minutes": 120, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_workshop_participants", "people": 40, "minutes": 90, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_attendees", "people": 200, "minutes": 0, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_volunteers", "people": 12, "minutes": 30, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_speakers", "people": 3, "minutes": 0, "must_replan": false}
   ],
   "to_confirm": ["Room B availability at Espace Mont Louis from 12:00 to 13:00 on 2026-11-21", "Room B capacity versus 40 workshop participants (capacity not stated)", "Whether participants can rearrange their day for a 12:00 start (time lost is an unsourced estimate)", "Whether the lunch schedule is affected by a 12:00-13:00 workshop", "Volunteer time needed to relocate and reset the room (estimate, not sourced)"]},

  {"id": "C", "title": "Keep original slot for the first hour and push the workshop to 12:00-13:00 with a shortened session",
   "changes": [{"node": "workshop_s2", "set": {"start": "12:00", "end": "12:45", "location": "Espace Mont Louis (11e), room B"}}],
   "capacity": null, "attendees": 200, "extra_cost_eur": null,
   "accessibility_ok": true, "within_opening_hours": true,
   "burdens": [
     {"group": "grp_speaker_2", "people": 1, "minutes": 120, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_workshop_participants", "people": 40, "minutes": 105, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_attendees", "people": 200, "minutes": 0, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_volunteers", "people": 12, "minutes": 45, "must_replan": false},
     {"group": "grp_speakers", "people": 3, "minutes": 0, "must_replan": false}
   ],
   "to_confirm": ["Whether Speaker 2 agrees to a 45-minute session instead of 60 minutes", "Room B capacity and availability from 12:00 to 12:45 at Espace Mont Louis", "Whether a shortened session changes the workshop content or agreement with the organizer", "Time lost by participants is an unsourced estimate", "Whether the room is accessible (not checked)"]}
]}
```
